rows.en: On the day of their 19th birthday, Kotaro and Nobuhiko… were abducted by a mysterious organization calling itself "Gorgom"…
All that remains… is to erase their memories as humans. With that, the modification surgery will be complete!

Wait!

This isn't what we agreed! Anything but erasing their memories! They are both my sons!

Professor Akizuki…

Kotaro and Nobuhiko are no longer your sons. They are the Century Kings, Black Sun!

Heh heh heh… Exactly so!

For that, I believe it will be a happier thing for your sons… no, for the Century Kings… to have their human memories erased and be born anew.
Stop iiiit!
Daaaaad!!
Kotaro, never mind me! Run! Ruuun!
Dad, Nobuhiko…
K-Kotaro…
I see… So the SSI has it rough too. Here you go.

Thank you, I'll have some…

Oh? Do you like photography too, Mr. Tachibana?
…What makes you say that?

That camera on display over there… It's not the kind an amateur would own, so I wondered.

I may not look it, but I'm a professional photographer…

Oh? Now that's impressive.

Then I'll bet you'd get along with Hayato.
Hayato?
He's the owner of that camera. He's away from Japan right now for his own reasons… but even far away, he's my closest friend.
Excuse me…
Welcome! Take any empty seat…
Um… I…
Let's see… Coffee, or tea? Our cocoa's pretty good too, you know.
I can't drink…

Huh?

I've met people who can't drink alcohol, but coffee and tea too? You're an unusual young lady for this day and age…

That's not it…

I'm looking for Ichiro. There's something I need to tell him… I heard I could meet him if I came here.

Oh, you know Ichiro?

Even so… those two pop up and vanish like ghosts. When he'll come by next… I haven't the faintest idea!

He won't carry a cell phone either, says the signal's bad for his body. What a pain!
I see…

…Oh? Look at the time!

Mr. Tachibana, thank you for the treat. I'll drop by again when I'm in the neighborhood! By the way, your shop's clock is running slow. Well then…
Sorry about that, Mari…

Still, what a pain! Is this clock broken?

Sorry, but… I'm going to fetch a screwdriver from the back. Mind the shop for a moment, would you?

Whew, sorry, sorry…

Huh? Where did that girl go? Geez… Can't be helped. Now then, the clock, the clock…

…!?

What…!? It's completely fixed? Don't tell me that girl…? No, no, that's ridiculous! But who on earth is she?
Have you still not found Dr. Barnes?
Hmph, just be quiet and watch! Washi Beast has found his son, Ben. Capturing Dr. Barnes is only a matter of time.
The Radiation Clean System is essential for us, Madou, Makuu and Fuuma, to invade the planets!
I know that! Leave it to me!!
Everything's ready…
Okay…
Isn't that dangerous for you two? If lightning strikes, you'll be killed!
Please don't get in our way! This is the trouble with uneducated people.
We're doing research on lightning.
Hmm…
It's fine… All of the lightning's energy gets absorbed into the lab's equipment.
The lightning's energy?
Whoa! Look out!!

Ha ha ha…

Found you at last! Now, you'll take me to Dr. Barnes!

…!?

Who's there? You mean to interfere, do you? Find him, find him! Eliminate him!
Ah…!?

…!?

Are you the space crime syndicate Madou? What are you scheming?
Grr… That's none of your business!
It's dangerous! Run to the lab!
Okay…
Taaah!!
Impudent… Washi Beast, attack! Eliminate him!!
Hyeeeh, hyeeeh!!
Dad…!?
Kotaro, I was worried about you…
What is Gorgom? What's your connection to it!? Dad… you can't mean…!?
Kotaro… I am, just as you suspect, a member of Gorgom.

Since that day, I have been as good as a dead man.

What I'm about to tell you is the truth. Stay calm and listen carefully! Yes… It was 19 years ago now.
We've captured the Kyurians!!
The Kyurians? That race with psychic powers?

Indeed…

Among them, we caught the brat called Ozuma, who has the strongest esper powers of all…
When Ozuma turns 18, he will begin to wield terrifying esper powers! He will make a fine addition to Fuuma's forces.
Hessler, use the growth-amplifying sound waves… Make Ozuma grow up rapidly and turn him into a weapon at once!
Ohohohoho… Zero-One! You won't escape me today.

…!?

Bijinder… Stop it, I don't want to fight you.
I am an evil robot born of Shadow! Zero-One, prepare yourself!!
Taaah!! Ohohohoho…
Interfere any further… and you'll regret it!
Hold it! General Guiler! What are you scheming this time? I won't let Madou do as it pleases!

Space Sheriff Sharivan!?

Silence! Eliminate him!!
We'll call this match a draw for now!

Around the time you two were born… your father and I were absorbed in excavating ancient ruins.

But excavating those ruins ended up costing far more money than we had ever imagined…

Raising funds wasn't going well either. We were struggling, just about ready to give up, and right at that moment…

Gorgom offered us financial backing. I thought it was a gift from heaven!

But… there was a condition attached. The condition that we become members of Gorgom…

I agonized over it… But beggars can't be choosers. I decided to accept their backing.

But your father said he would never become a member of Gorgom, and turned them down flat!

…!?

Then that accident…?
They were murdered! My parents… by Gorgom!?
Why? Why did you ever become a member of Gorgom!?

uncertain: U06741: 世紀王ブラックサン with two subjects rendered "the Century Kings, Black Sun"; plural is awkward since only one becomes Black Sun.
U06749: SSI left as is (glossary); scene context not visible (Mari Matsubara's organization).
U06763: あいつら (plural) — Tachibana lumps Ichiro with others; rendered "those two"; could be "those guys".
U06770: [ja] — "his son" taken as Dr. Barnes's son Ben.
U06784/U06791: 抹殺 rendered "Eliminate him" (target is Ichiro, male).
U06816: 父さんたち (Kotaro's parents, who died in the "accident") rendered "My parents".

new_names.why: not in glossary; common English spellings
Kikaider 01 organization; not in glossary alone
from glossary forms ゼロワンキック etc.
